Plot the mean of each continuous indicator in each profile as bars

Source: R/wildcards.R
plot_bars.Rd

plot_bars() plots the mean of each continuous indicator in each profile as bars that start at zero.

Usage

plot_bars(x, main = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

Arguments

x

One of:

  • a profile fit from lpa() or multilpa(), with or without covariates, that has at least one continuous indicator;

  • a transition fit from lta() of class multilpa_transitions with at least one continuous indicator. The general transition fits (class multilpa_lta) are refused;

  • a diagnostics() result, which is drawn from the fit it checked.

main, subtitle

Title and subtitle of the plot. NULL (default) keeps the view's own text.

Value

A ggplot object.

Errors:

  • latents_nothing_to_plot when the package returned x but this function has no plot of it: a fit without continuous indicators (a latent class fit), an additive or cross-level fit, a mixture regression, a growth mixture, a general transition fit or an enumeration grid. For an object of the wrong kind, the message names the plot functions that apply to it;

  • latents_not_a_fit when x is not a fit, grid or other result of the package, for example a data frame;

  • latents_missing_package when ggplot2 is not installed.

Details

The x-axis lists the continuous indicators and the y-axis is the estimated mean, in each indicator's own units. Within an indicator there is one bar per profile, side by side. A profile has its own fill colour and its own marker at the end of its bar, shown in the legend. When the fit has standard errors, each bar carries its 95% interval; when it has none, the subtitle says why. Categorical, ordinal and count indicators are not drawn; a caption names them.

plot_profiles(x, what = "bars", scale = "standardized") draws the same bars in standard deviations, and intervals = FALSE there leaves the intervals out.

See also

plot_profiles() for the same means as lines and for the options of this view; plot_heatmap(), plot_raincloud().

Examples

fit <- lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"), n_profiles = 2,
           n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
plot_bars(fit)
